content:
Hi everyone,

We noticed that our Dataverse interface seems to display outdated information.

There are users publishing datasets but found it still listed as unpublished at folder/dataverse level interface, and the newly created folders are invisible. Also, creating new dataset generates error (shown in the screenshot below).

Is there any potential reasons for that?

Thanks!
Jack

@Jack Ng hi! I saw you posted the same thing at https://groups.google.com/g/dataverse-community/c/vKIAGLN-mJI/m/UgHcfNGOAQAJ but I wasn't sure what to say.

I'm still not sure. :grimacing:
Over there it says you're running Dataverse v5.10.1.
It sounds like you're having multiple problems.

@Philip Durbin 🚀
I'm not sure if these issues we are currently having the same cause or multiple causes. I have checked the server.log and couldn't locate anything related to the problematic dataset ID.

We have rebooted the server and the problem persists, I'm suspecting if this problem is caused by Solr.
I got this error message this morning when trying to create a new folder (dataverse). Could it be related to the Solr service and could it be restarted?
Definitely related. Maybe you should reinstall Solr and reindex everything.

Thanks Philip, we will look into this.

I notice that from the Harvard Dataverse documentation, it mentions that there may be downtime for a Solr reindexing and I wonder if we can do a test on this method first.

Currently I have a previously created unpublished dataset, and I have published it today and there is no update at the dataverse level. I'm wondering if I can simply reindex for my particular dataset first to see if it works (I have tried it and it failed, I'm not sure if I have followed the proper steps though). Also, could you please advise if there is a complete list of procedures and commands to restart Solr? Thanks so much.
